scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia! Do you know Moscovia?
the paradise spreading on the endless seas...
Welcome to Moscovia
It's adventurous and mystic.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚！您听说过莫斯科比亚吗？
那是建立在无尽海洋上的乐园...
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚
这里充满冒险与神秘。

scripts.text: About Moscovia...
scripts.translation: 关于莫斯科比亚...

scripts.text: Go to Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia is a beautiful kingdom
on an island located north of Rune-
Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
莫斯科比亚是一个美丽的王国，
位于卢恩·米德加兹北部的岛屿上。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sure that you will be
absolutely fascinated
by Moscovia's beautiful scenery
and gorgeous palace.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
我相信您一定会被莫斯科比亚
美丽的风景和宏伟的宫殿
深深吸引。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Now that our long winter has
passed,
I'm happy that I can now show you
our gorgeous hometown.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
漫长的冬天终于过去了，
我很高兴现在能向您展示
我们美丽的家乡。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you feel like visiting Moscovia
take the chance now!
I'll help you to have a nice trip
to Moscovia!
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果您想去莫斯科比亚，
现在就是好机会！
我会帮您度过一段愉快的旅程！

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, let us start now.
You should pay me 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia.
But when you come back,
you don't have to pay.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
好的，那我们出发吧。
前往莫斯科比亚需要支付10,000 Zeny。
但当您回来时，
不需要再付费。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Can we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
我们现在可以出发了吗？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果您现在太忙，
请随时再来找我。
我随时准备引导任何人前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sorry but you don't have
enough zeny now
You need 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
很抱歉，您现在的Zeny不足。
前往莫斯科比亚需要10,000 Zeny。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, we're leaving now.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
好的，我们现在出发了。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果您现在太忙，
请随时再来找我。
我随时准备引导任何人前往莫斯科比亚。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
How was your trip?
Do you have good memories from Moscovia?
A ship is now leaving
for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
旅途如何？
您在莫斯科比亚有美好的回忆吗？
现在有一艘船正驶向
卢恩·米德加兹。

scripts.text: Return to Alberta
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you want to see more
please take your time.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
如果您还想多看一会儿，
请慢慢欣赏。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Please come and visit soon.
Ok then, Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚公关官员]
请常来参观。
好的，那我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Our dear Csar Alexsay III is in the palace.
He rules over Moscovia.
Please be careful not to cause him any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们敬爱的沙皇 亚历克赛三世在宫殿里。
他统治着莫斯科比亚。
请小心不要给他惹麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please be silent or the Csar will be angry.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
请保持安静，否则沙皇会生气的。
